findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] docker-compose.yml: every service carries explicit memory and PID limits. web mem_limit: 1g / memswap_limit: 1g / pids_limit: 256 (lines 47-49); proxy mem_limit: 256m / memswap_limit: 256m / pids_limit: 128 (lines 117-119); db mem_limit: 1g / memswap_limit: 1g / pids_limit: 256 (lines 177-179). memswap_limit equal to mem_limit prevents swap from absorbing an overage. Defence in depth: cpus caps, ulimits nofile 1024/2048, cgroup_parent: restaurant.slice, and tmpfs mounts sized (e.g. /tmp:size=64m line 25). How-to I945 canonical pattern (--memory plus --pids-limit) satisfied on all three services. Marker scan clean | verdict=pass confidence=high
